extracted.intended_audience: patent researchers, IP professionals, inventors, and other users seeking Japanese and international patent information
extracted.subtask_description: Description and feature list for J‑PlatPat, a free online platform for searching Japanese and selected foreign patent publications, JPO dossiers, and related industrial property information. Useful for locating bibliographic records, full text, dossier/legal status, and performing advanced searches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access and provider
rubrics_metrics.description: Provider: Japan Patent Office (JPO) and National Center for Industrial Property Information and Training (INPIT); Fee: Free
rubrics_metrics.guidance: J-PlatPat is a free of charge service provided by JPO and INPIT.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose / database description
rubrics_metrics.description: J-PlatPat is a free of charge service for searching industrial property information over the Internet. It provides industrial property information such as Japanese publications on patents, utility models, designs, and trademarks issued by the Japan Patent Office (JPO) and other foreign publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also provides JPO dossier information and acts as patent information infrastructure in Japan with enhanced search functions and user interface to efficiently find industrial information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coverage (collections and text availability)
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage: Patent Collections including Bibliographic data, Full text, Partial text for multiple jurisdictions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit coverage entries: Japan (Bibliographic data, Full text), United States of America (Bibliographic data, Full text), European Patent Office (EPO) (Bibliographic data, Full text), Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) (Bibliographic data, Full text), China (Bibliographic data, Full text), Republic of Korea (Bibliographic data, Full text), United Kingdom (Bibliographic data), Germany (Bibliographic data), France (Bibliographic data), Switzerland (Bibliographic data), Canada (Bibliographic data).

rubrics_metrics.name: JPO dossier information / legal status visibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides JPO dossier information, which allows easy viewing of the current progress of applications going through the examination process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dossier info gives insight into application progress and legal status; useful for tracking prosecution and changes during examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alerts / legal status notification
rubrics_metrics.description: As Alerts service, J-PlatPat provides the JPO dossier information notification through an RSS feed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users can subscribe to RSS notifications to stay informed about dossier/legal status changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interface languages and search interfaces
rubrics_metrics.description: Language: English, Japanese. Interfaces: General search tools, Non-Latin character search, Classification search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site supports both English and Japanese user interfaces and includes tools to handle searches with non-Latin characters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Classification systems supported
rubrics_metrics.description: Highlights: FI/F-Terms and International Patent Classification (IPC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search and classification browsing support FI/F-Terms and IPC to help locate patents by classification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search operators and truncation
rubrics_metrics.description: General operators: Boolean (AND, OR, NOT, XOR); Proximity (within range); Wildcard operators: 0-1 characters, 1 character, unlimited characters; Truncation: Center truncation, Left truncation, Right truncation; SLART.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See 'Appendix A Search Tips' in Operation Manual for details on syntax and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Results features (display and analysis)
rubrics_metrics.description: Results type: Keyword in context (KWIC) highlighting; Machine translation; Analysis: Statistical.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search results include KWIC highlighting and machine translation to help interpret foreign-language documents; statistical analysis tools are available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data export and download options
rubrics_metrics.description: Data Export: Bibliographic data and classification are downloadable in a CSV format. CSV format files can only be output when there are 100 or fewer search results. Patent publications and dossiers are available and downloadable in a PDF. Exportable items also include Description and/or claims and Dossiers and Full document scans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note CSV export limit (<=100 results). PDFs of full publications and dossier documents are available for download.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value-added data (IDs and family data)
rubrics_metrics.description: Value added data: Standardized ID numbers and Patent family data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Japan Patent Office issues Identification Number for every applicant, attorney, agent, etc. Identification Number consists of nine-digit number. Patent family data: Simple family data and patent family data available in Open Patent Services (OPS).

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaboration tools and cross-resource linking
rubrics_metrics.description: Collaboration tools: J-GLOBAL integration allows searching domestic researchers and scholarly articles via a selection in Document types.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selecting 'J-GLOBAL' in 'Document types' and searching makes it possible to search J‑GLOBAL for non-patent documents, science technology terms, chemical substances, and materials information, enabling cross-resource research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-patent content availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Non-patent data: Industrial designs and Non-patent literature including Journal of technical disclosure, manuals, books, company technical reports, proceedings, etc. which are approved to be made available in the J‑PlatPat.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Platform includes certain non-patent literature and industrial design information, useful for broader prior art and technical context searches.
